name: Village Guardian
flavor_text: A stalwart protector of Whisperbrook's humble streets and homes. Their ember-touched blade has defended countless hearths from bandits and beasts.

abilities.name: Shatter Gate
abilities.description: Channel fiery strength to break through wooden doors, barriers, or weak walls with explosive force.

abilities.name: Village Authority
abilities.description: Draw upon your reputation as protector to intimidate troublemakers and command respect from locals.

abilities.name: Forge Slam
abilities.description: Strike with the fury of the village smithy, delivering a crushing blow that echoes like hammer on anvil.

abilities.name: Defender's Call
abilities.description: Rally nearby villagers or allies with a stirring cry that kindles courage in their hearts.

portrait_prompt: A sturdy warrior in simple leather armor with a flame-touched sword, standing before a quaint village backdrop with thatched roofs and stone chimneys

ability_pool.name: Rooftop Leap
ability_pool.description: Scale cottage walls and leap between rooftops with surprising agility and strength.

ability_pool.name: Trouble Sense
ability_pool.description: Your connection to the village alerts you to brewing conflicts or approaching danger.

ability_pool.name: Tavern Brawl
ability_pool.description: Grapple foes with the practiced ease of someone who's broken up countless bar fights.

ability_pool.name: Battle Cry of the Hearth
ability_pool.description: Let loose a thunderous roar that channels the protective fury of every village guardian.

name: Candlewick Scholar
flavor_text: A learned keeper of Whisperbrook's small but treasured library. They weave light magic by candlelight, illuminating both darkness and ignorance.

spells.name: Lantern Bolt
spells.description: Hurl a focused beam of warm light that burns like concentrated sunlight.

spells.name: Candleflame Dart
spells.description: Launch a small but precise dart of flickering light that seeks its target.

spells.name: Reading Room Radiance
spells.description: Fill an area with brilliant illumination that sears multiple enemies with holy light.

spells.name: Scholar's Focus
spells.description: Enhance your mental clarity and magical precision through studious concentration.

spell_pool.name: Library Blaze
spell_pool.description: Engulf multiple foes in the purifying light of accumulated knowledge and wisdom.

spell_pool.name: Midnight Oil

spell_pool.name: Eternal Flame
